risksForTheParent: REPLAY, and the single most reviewable thing on this head: the reader stops being a one-name reader. Any caller that previously relied on 'anything but root is refused' as an implicit guard against reading a REWOUND stream now gets events back when the head sits on 'main'. That is the intended semantics - LIVE_PATH_BRANCH_IDS already declares the two names as one line - but it means the refusal is no longer the thing that distinguishes a rewound stream. What distinguishes it stays isLivePathBranchId at the mirror (MatchStreamJournalMirror.ts:228) and at the admission/recovery consults, all unchanged on this head

The message on the surviving refusal changes text (it now names both live-path ids). Any assertion matching the old string by substring would break; the existing row asserts only `rejects.toBeInstanceOf(EventHistoryBranchError)`, and the full-package run is what measures whether any other suite matched the text

A REAL match stream's genesis branch is backfilled as 'root' (SQLiteEventHistoryBranchStore.backfillGenesisBranches, used by the existing preview test at :279), while the MIRROR writes onto 'main' when no effective head exists yet (MatchStreamJournalMirror.ts:227). This head makes the reader answer on both, but it does NOT reconcile which of the two a given match's branch records actually name - that reconciliation is not in this unit and is not claimed
